mods.name: NoCheating
mods.description: Locks World Options and Open to LAN cheat controls on worlds created without commands, so Survival saves cannot enable cheats after the fact.

releases.notes: # NoCheating 1.0 — Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric) First release. Client-only. On worlds created **without commands** and **not in Creative**, this version disables: - **World Options** in Options - **Game Mode** and **Allow Cheats** on Open to LAN Disabled buttons stay visible and show a tooltip. Creative worlds and worlds created with cheats stay unlocked. **Requires:** Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or later, Fabric API. English and Brazilian Portuguese. MIT.

readmeSummary: A client-side Fabric mod that keeps Survival worlds from turning cheats on after you create them.
